in_marathi.name: Devaki
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devaki हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devaki is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘deva’, meaning ‘god’. The name signifies a goddess or a divine being. In Hindu mythology, Devaki is the name of the mother of Lord Krishna.
